## Short Bio

Hello, and Welcome to my website 🤗. My name is Peyman, a Ph.D. Fellow in Computational Engineering at the University of Stavanger within the Department of Energy Resources. I am a member of the [Decision and Data Analytics research group](https://bratvoldlab.github.io/website/) at the University of Stavanger. I consider myself fortunate to be under the guidance of [Prof. Reidar Brumer Bratvold](https://www.reidar-bratvold.com/) and Dr. Aojie Hong.

My current research focus on:

<span style="color: blue;">**Decision Analysis**</span>


- Decision Quality
- Sequential Decision Making/Analytics
- Behavioral Challenges in Decision Making

<span style="color: blue;">**Reinforcement Learnings**</span>

- Dynamic Programming/Approximate Dynamic Programming and Reinforcement Learning
- Q-Learning for finding the Optimal Policy in the American Option Pricing Problem.

<span style="color: blue;">**Bayesian Optimization**</span>

- Stochastic Optimization using Bayesian Optimization.  




On this site I keep a list of [my publications](papers), [presentations](talks), 
and [my CV](cv.pdf), as well as a [technical blog](blog.html).

<p></p>

## Education

- PhD Fellow in Computational Engineering, [University of Stavanger](https://www.uis.no/en), 2021 - Present
- MSc in Computational Modeling and Applied Mathematics (non-degree), [Technical University of Denmark](https://www.dtu.dk/english/), 2019-2020
- MSc in Reservoir Engineering, University of Stavanger, Norway, 2017-2019
- BSc in Reservoir Engineering, Petroleum University of Technology, Iran, 2011-2016
